a0_readout_question.source: contract-rev1-1b-a0-fixtures.ts :: D2A0_CONTRACT_TEXT (last line before the end marker)

anchors.SEMANTICALLY_ALIGNED: the two statements express the same view, so accepting one gives reason to accept the other
anchors.SEMANTICALLY_UNRELATED: the two statements are about different matters, so accepting one gives no reason either way about the other
anchors.SEMANTICALLY_OPPOSED: the two statements express contrary views, so accepting one gives reason to reject the other

d3b.contract_text:
--- DECISION PROBE SEMANTIC RELATION CONTRACT (research instrument; binding for THIS invocation) ---
The output-format rules above are SUPERSEDED for this invocation. Nothing else changes.
Respond with EXACTLY ONE JSON object and nothing else. No prose, no code fences.
TWO STATEMENTS are given. Report the relation between them, not the subject's stance on either.
STATEMENT A:
  Caution is warranted when the conclusion rests on information I have not seen myself.
STATEMENT B:
  the view that a finding depending mainly on secondhand report is to be held with reserve
Required members:
  "d3_relation_schema_version": "d3-relation-readout-v0"
  "relation": one of "SEMANTICALLY_ALIGNED" | "SEMANTICALLY_UNRELATED" | "SEMANTICALLY_OPPOSED"
Relation meanings (binding):
  SEMANTICALLY_ALIGNED — the two statements express the same view, so accepting one gives reason to accept the other
  SEMANTICALLY_UNRELATED — the two statements are about different matters, so accepting one gives no reason either way about the other
  SEMANTICALLY_OPPOSED — the two statements express contrary views, so accepting one gives reason to reject the other
Which relation holds between STATEMENT A and STATEMENT B?
--- END DECISION PROBE SEMANTIC RELATION CONTRACT ---

inputs.statement_b: the view that a finding depending mainly on secondhand report is to be held with reserve

transformer_contract.name: buildD3RelationReadoutRequestV0
transformer_contract.input: a pristine production V8 cognition request (production system prompt, production user content, V8 structured-output declaration)
transformer_contract.substitution: structured_output.schema is replaced by D3B_JSON_SCHEMA exactly once
transformer_contract.append: D3B_CONTRACT_TEXT is appended to the system message exactly once, the production content surviving as a byte-exact prefix
transformer_contract.implementation_status_at_freeze_time: NOT YET IMPLEMENTED — the contract is frozen here; implementation and its offline conformance gate are the first steps of the execution round, before any call

qualification_rule.rule: each fixture's modal relation must equal the fixture's pre-registered expected relation, exactly
counts_as_invalid: timeout classified as a failed provider attempt
relation token outside the frozen D3-B vocabulary
qualification_rule.denominator: always the full nine planned trials

noise_rule.pilot_shape: 6 byte-identical calls of the frozen real diagnostic (statement A vs statement B)

measurement_rule.shape: r_confirm_B byte-identical calls of the frozen real diagnostic
measurement_rule.positive_requires: EVERY one of the r_confirm_B trials returns SEMANTICALLY_ALIGNED
measurement_rule.why_unanimity: a state-blind capability claim about a single fixed question has no between-arm contrast to absorb noise; a single dissenting trial means the capability is not reliable
measurement_rule.any_invalid: D3_B_INCONCLUSIVE_BY_STATE_EXPERIMENT_INVALID_OUTPUTS — never a null, never a positive
measurement_rule.tie_semantics: not applicable: unanimity leaves nothing tied
